The '''221 cyber-interface''' was a model of neural [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Lyle Lippstroot]] was fitted with a 221 cyber-interface, which caused his death when a [[Bartokk program-trap]] was introduced into it.<ref name="J15" />
